name: Datavera
description: Publish real public datasets to your Datavera account, check analytics and reply to comments. Includes the dataset-publisher pipeline (search → download → analyse → charts → publish), the Datavera account connector and skills.
author: Datavera

settings.label: Datavera API key
settings.help: On datavera.io open Account → API Keys, tick Read and Publish, press Generate key, then Copy key. It starts with dv_sk_ (personal) or dv_co_ (company). Making a new key switches the old one off.

settings.label: Publish as
settings.help: You personally, or one of your companies. Press 'Check and connect' to load your choices.

settings.label: Subjects to look for
settings.help: Comma-separated, e.g. 'glacier mass balance, solar capacity by country'. Empty = a ready-made mixed list. Narrow subjects work better than broad ones.

settings.label: Submit automatically for review
settings.help: On: finished datasets go to Datavera's review queue. Off: they stay as drafts for you to check first. Runs with warnings always stay as drafts.

settings.label: Import from the command-line agent (optional)
settings.help: If you used the earlier command-line agent, choose its folder (e.g. C:\DataveraAgent) to bring over its catalogue and history so nothing is repeated.

connectors.name: Datavera
connectors.description: Your Datavera account: datasets, uploads, publishing, analytics and comments.

actions.label: Sync my catalogue
actions.help: Refresh the local list of your datasets (prevents duplicates). Read-only.

schedule_templates.name: Publish one dataset every day
schedule_templates.prompt: Find and publish one new dataset.

schedule_templates.name: Weekly Datavera analytics summary
schedule_templates.prompt: Using the Datavera connector, summarise my datasets' views, likes and new comments over the last week. List comments that need a reply.
